title: Jake Whisenant, Who Raced Up Yosemite’s El Capitan at Record Speed, Dies in a Fall
summary: Authorities in California said he died in a climbing accident. He set a record in 2024 for climbing El Capitan’s Lurking Fear route in under three hours.
